summary: Few points end in an ask; how many asks a speech makes is the speaker's trait and the kind of speech.
realLife: Only 15% of points ended in an ask, and asks per speech ran from none (Lincoln, Lujan Grisham) to eight (Hobbs).
sources: docs/story/research/address-moves.md (Elections lane, Nov 24, 2026: 6 inaugurals and 6 State of the State addresses read whole, 175 points coded)
